edges.reason: constructor assigns creator = msg.sender
auth_list is keyed and checked with msg.sender
ValidHandleAuth uses tx.origin/msg.sender to authorize SetAuth writes into auth_list
OwnerAble require(acc == tx.origin) gates Withdraw authorization via tx.origin
GetDayCount(now) drives all g_Bonus reward accounting (timestamp dependency)
chip usage counters depend on now when expiring temp entries
Accelerate depends on block.timestamp to compute remaining cooldown
Withdraw uses now for day accounting and player refresh
Withdraw reads g_Bonus record and player state
Withdraw performs external ETH transfer to acc before finalizing all state
MasterWithdraw reads g_Bonus reward balance
external ETH transfer to receiver address
Child.AddBonus calls into g_Main for bonus bookkeeping
ETH is transferred to g_Main before AddBonus state update
kill force-sends balance to creator via selfdestruct
CreatorAble require(msg.sender == creator) gates kill
CreatorAble gates the one-shot SyncOldData migration
ValidHandleAuth requires tx.origin or msg.sender equal to creator
SetAuth writes true into auth_list
ClearAuth deletes an auth_list entry
ResolveChips loops calling into Main for each chip
ResolveChips consumes chips via g_Main.CostChip
ResolveChips grants points via g_Main.GainStuff
Create spends general stuff through g_Main.CostStuff
Create stores rolled chips through g_Boilers.GenerateChips
Create invokes ProductionBoiler contract
Collect queries boiler validity/expiry on external contract
Collect retrieves chips via g_Boilers.CollectChips
Accelerate reads boiler info from external production boiler
GenChipByRandomWeight calls g_Main to draw and consume a chip
SyncOldData pulls legacy data from untrusted old contract
GainCard mutates state through g_Main cross-contract interaction
AuthAble require(auth_list[msg.sender]) gates GainCard
AuthAble gates GainStuff bag mutation
ResolveChips relies on Main AuthAble checks for CostChip/GainStuff
GetChipUsedNum reads chip usage counters from g_ChipLib
GenRandom mixes msg.sender into its pseudo-random derivation
GenRandom uses now as a randomness source (timestamp dependency)
pos parameter drives the insert loop whose counter increments instead of decrementing, corrupting array growth
sub computes iOld-num then delegates to add/set; unchecked underflow risk under solc 0.4.x
acc parameter is the recipient and authentication subject of Withdraw
idx parameter selects which boiler Collect operates on
costAll local determines cost branch and cooldown inside Create
seed local is advanced by GenRandom on each draw
bonus local holds the payout computed and transferred in Withdraw
GainStuff writes into the g_BagList entry for the account
GainCard reads card metadata from g_CardLib

normalization_plan.reason: acc parameter of Withdraw is only meaningful inside Withdraw, so fold it into that core function
idx parameter of Collect selects the boiler and should be merged into the Collect function
costAll local is a Create-internal computation and belongs with the Create function
seed local of GenRandom only advances within GenRandom, so merge into that function
pos parameter of IndexList.insert is the direct driver of the buggy insert logic, merge into insert
bonus local is produced and consumed solely inside Withdraw, merge into the Withdraw function
